verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 product page documents DLSS 4 AI-powered upscaling for this card, which covers the upscaling part of the story. It frames DLSS around real-time photorealistic rendering for professional workflows rather than gaming. The Optical Flow SDK's video frame interpolation is a separate developer SDK, not in-game frame generation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented frame generation for this part, evidence of broad game support, any gaming-focused or hands-on corroboration of DLSS on this card.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support

citations.quote: DLSS 4 enhances performance and visual fidelity through AI-powered upscaling, enabling real-time photorealistic rendering.
